description: exp_g_0025 - the CLEAN one-variable compress ablation of exp_n_0045. Exactly ONE field differs from exp_n_0045_H8_d48_tph256_nap7_16k: lut_inner_in_dim 48 -> -1, which drops the compress projection so the FFN LUT routes on the full 384-d slot input. Everything else is held: inner_out_dim=48 (decompress kept), nap=7, tph=256, n_heads=8, joint_head_compression=False, forward_mode=hard, learnable_temps=True, depth 6, n_embd 384, n_head 6, plain Linear attention, seq 512, vocab 32768, tied unembedder, AdamW, 24,576 tok/step, eval_every 200, 16,000 steps, seed 1. CONTRAST WITH exp_g_0024, which is NOT a clean ablation: it also changed n_heads 8 -> 1 and tph 256 -> 2048, so its -0.035 gap against exp_n_0045 confounds the dropped compress with a completely different head/table geometry. This experiment isolates the compress projection alone. train.py is byte-identical to exp_n_0045's; the change is config-only (LUT_IN is read straight from lut_inner_in_dim, whose source comment already documents -1 => no compress). Shared lutorch NOT modified. ARM: the STOCK per-head-loop CompressionMultiHeadLUT. With inner_in_dim=-1 the stock class falls back to a loop over 8 single-head FastMHLs, which is exactly the code path exp_n_0045 ran (2026-08-19, one day before the batched path landed in 3328bf5c) and which gives each head its OWN (log_soft_score_temp, log_select_temp) -- 16 per slot, matching the exp_n_0045 checkpoint's 93,403,488 params and its profiler line 'path=per-head-loop'. Param check: 92,516,448 == 93,403,488 - 887,040, i.e. EXACTLY the six compress Linears and nothing else. The local local_mh_compression.BatchedNoCompressMHL override is retained in the tree but NOT used: batching would collapse temps 16 -> 2 per slot (-84 params, a second variable) and costs memory (one [N,2048,128] backward tensor: 6.44 GB at bs=12, 25.77 GB at 48) instead of saving it. BATCH: device_batch_size 48, grad_accum 1, eval_steps 10 -- identical to exp_n_0045, so there is ZERO batch-size difference from the reference.
